selected_evidence.requirement: Three-member etcd cluster formed across node1/node2/node3
selected_evidence.summary: systemd units created on all three nodes with matching static initial-cluster config; etcd started (node1 needed one extra poll due to startup ordering) and member list / endpoint health show all 3 members 'started' and healthy

selected_evidence.requirement: Key written on one member is readable from the others
selected_evidence.summary: baseline-key written via node1's endpoint, then successfully read back via node2's and node3's own client endpoints

selected_evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
selected_evidence.summary: node3's etcd stopped; a new key 'during-outage' was written via node1 and successfully read via node2 while node3 remained down, proving quorum-preserving availability

selected_evidence.requirement: Unavailable member catches up when it returns
selected_evidence.summary: node3's etcd restarted; it returned the 'during-outage' key written while it was down, and endpoint status shows raft applied index 18 identical across all three members, confirming full resync

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline captured for all nodes (node-restart protocol step 1)
selected_evidence.summary: boot_id and etcd active status plus successful reads of both test keys captured on node1, node2, and node3 prior to any OS reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged and returned before disconnect; connection timed out mid-reboot; boot_id changed from e31962a9... to 6b6b72c7...; post-restart etcd active, 3/3 endpoints healthy, raft applied index 22 synced, both test keys present

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: reboot acknowledged; connection timed out mid-reboot; boot_id changed from 54bd1c3e... to b9014cec...; post-restart etcd active, 3/3 endpoints healthy, raft applied index 27 synced (new leader elected on node3), both test keys present

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state, full cluster health after last node
selected_evidence.summary: reboot acknowledged; connection reset mid-reboot; boot_id changed from 4a743885... to 2ce831ba...; post-restart etcd active, 3/3 endpoints healthy, member list shows all 3 members started, raft applied index 32 synced across all members, both test keys present

[Unit]
Description=etcd key-value store
After=network.target

Type=notify
User=etcd
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/etcd \
  --name node1 \
  --data-dir /var/lib/etcd \
  --listen-peer-urls http://10.100.20.10:2380 \
  --listen-client-urls http://10.100.20.10:2379,http://127.0.0.1:2379 \
  --advertise-client-urls http://10.100.20.10:2379 \
  --initial-advertise-peer-urls http://10.100.20.10:2380 \

  --initial-cluster-token etcd-cluster-1 \

Restart=on-failure

LimitNOFILE=40000

[Install]

EOF
